paragraphs: Every day at school, we wear a white shirt. We wear blue shorts or a blue skirt, too. That is a little boring. But today is Dress-Up Day! We walk into the classroom in funny clothes. Teacher Kim stands by the door. She is very surprised. "Wow! Who are you all?" she asks. Now I tell you about our clothes.

I have a red coat and a yellow hat. My boots are green. I have a small blue bag, too. Mia has a gray sweater and a long gray tail. She has two small gray ears on her head, too. Leo has his big red hat. Everyone laughs at his big hat. His shirt is purple. His socks are different. One sock is yellow, and one sock is yellow and white. May is a pirate. She has a black hat and a red scarf. A toy parrot sits on her shoulder.

"Who has the best clothes?" asks Teacher Kim. "We all do!" says Leo. Teacher Kim laughs. She says, "I think you all look great." Then she puts on a funny blue hat, too. Teacher Kim says, "Please stand in a line." We stand in a line for a class photo. The photo is on the wall now. "Dress-Up Day is not boring at all," says Mia. We all smile. What do you wear on a funny day? Which clothes do you like best?
text.summary: It is Dress-Up Day at school. Lily tells us what she, Mia, Leo, May, and Teacher Kim wear, and the class takes a photo.
